review_note: Title alone ("Day County Emergency Declaration") carries no hazard keyword the automatic classifier can match. The order itself and contemporaneous coverage confirm it was issued for basin flooding from spring snowmelt runoff that damaged Day County's road system beginning around April 6 2020.
Bare word 'Fire' in title ('State of Emergency - Fire') doesn't match the classifier's wildfire/forest fire/brush fire pattern; the order itself is a wildfire response declaration.
Title is 'Wildland Fire' - the classifier's fire keyword requires wildfire/forest fire/brush fire as compound terms, not this phrasing.
Title is 'Fire Disaster Declaration' - same bare-fire-word gap as the other SD fire entries.
Title is 'Extend Emergency and Wildland Fire' - same bare-fire-word gap; this is an extension of an existing wildfire declaration.
